notes.title: Unlock the Feelings is available now for FREE! Plus an amazing DLC.
notes.content:
[b]Unlock the Feelings[/b] is live now!
In this strategy game inspired by Wordle and Mastermind, find the correct sequence of 1 Arena and 4 Little Inner Monsters.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/e221834f41ee0918b7b45fe4c3a2cb30433c3e01.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/fe4423f45c907d67e3015dbfdcd2f512f3906b81.jpg[/img]

It features the Little Inner Monsters, our feelings portrayed as cute monsters.
The game is [b]FREE and COMPLETE[/b].😃
Play as much as you want: no daily limits, no paid additional content, no paywall.

While we advance on developing the Little Inner Monsters card game, we're also releasing [b]an amazing DLC including[/b]:
[list]
[*] a beautiful Little Inner Monsters [b]Artbook[/b], 
[*] [b]printable cards[/b] to play a physical version of the card game, and 
[*] the [b]soundtrack[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Happy 2022! See our next games
notes.content:
[b]Happy 2022 to our friends![/b] We wish you a year full of moments of joy and peace!

We're excited to tell you about some of our releases for the year.

[h1]Little Inner Monsters[/h1]
[b]Little Inner Monsters[/b] is the closest to release. It's a card game about emotions and feelings that you can play against a friend or against the computer.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/76273931635d8b0811b5350480359b42c425550c.png[/img]

The Steam page is active and you can add it to a wish list and follow it for updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1813190/Little_Inner_Monsters__Card_Game/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=ms_page


[h1]Christine[/h1]
[b]Christine[/b] is an interactive story about a young orphan working at the Paris Opera, with an untapped talent for singing. This game will take longer to be released, but we're working hard on it and hope you like it.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/034b846e870289df118b9d991d0c7363004f4dc4.png[/img]

The Steam page is also live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691500/Christine/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=ms_page

Both projects are being carried out in partnership with our friends Katia Numakura, producing the illustrations, and Tatyana Jacques, creating the music and sound design.
In addition to working with us on many games, they also have other amazing creations. Follow them on Instagram: 
[url=https://instagram.com/katia.numakura]@katia.numakura[/url]
[url=https://instagram.com/taty_jacques]@taty_jacques[/url]

If you are not following our Steam developer's page yet, follow it now to keep track of our news!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Work in progress & trivia
notes.content:
Katia Numakura, the Brazilian artist who's creating the game Christine with us, posted in her Instagram stories some work-in-progress and trivia about the game.

We'll post them here too! She posted in Portuguese and we're translating them. 

Any curiosity about the "Christine" game? ❤️ 

- When can I play it? 
- Very soon!😃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40973083/fb244e8c39e9cd73e7e9d6123cc351312dcfcb8f.png[/img]

- What is it about? 
- It's about a girl who dreams of being a soprano and her day-to-day training to win the singing contest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40973083/3807d353759b078eb49c2ca27a24c4aa0dc20708.png[/img]

- Where does the game take place? 
- In Paris!😍❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40973083/b4f8e6595c73cee006ae74e92387169318cf993b.png[/img]
